captureMethod.description: Same capture-only method as the 3000.6.14 capture: a minimal throwaway project with .devin/hooks.v1.json (native format, no outer 'hooks' wrapper) wiring SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, PostCompaction (7 events, blank matchers) to a single .devin/capture-logger.ts bun script. The logger reads one JSON event from stdin, writes it pretty-printed to a uniquely named file under ./captures/ (global sequence number, also ordered by mtime), writes NOTHING to stdout, and exits 0. NEW FINDING: SubagentStop is NOT a loadable event key — registering it in .devin/hooks.v1.json makes the CLI log 'unknown variant `SubagentStop`' and loads 0 hooks (the whole file is poisoned). It was therefore registered in .claude/settings.json instead, where the same unknown-variant warning skips only that file while the devin provider still loads (loaded=7, by_provider=[devin=7]).
captureMethod.subagentStopConfigPath: .claude/settings.json (SubagentStop entry only — it could NOT go in hooks.v1.json, see C16)
captureMethod.permissionModeNote: C14 (child write/edit) used --permission-mode accept-edits (auto-approves workspace edits only; NOT the broad 'dangerous' mode the runbook forbids). C05'/C06'/C11/C12 used the default 'auto' mode. No global configuration was changed.
captureMethod.trustNote: --respect-workspace-trust false skips the trust prompt that non-interactive -p mode cannot display on a scratch dir. Hooks DO fire under this flag (verified again on 3000.10.31).
captureMethod.orderingNote: Capture filenames carry a global sequence number and are confirmed by mtime; interleaved parent/child events (child tool calls and child Stops inside the parent's blocked read_subagent window, a parent Stop while a background child is still in-flight) reflect true arrival order at the single hook stream.

sanitization: Real hook stdin captured live. Only paths, session_id slugs, prompt_id UUIDs, tool_use_id hexes, agent_id hexes, shell ids, and verbose prompt text were replaced with placeholders in captured-3000.10.31.json. Property names, nesting, booleans, missing-vs-null distinctions, response status, correlation relationships, and event order are preserved exactly. Agent-authored report/stop text is kept verbatim where it is load-bearing evidence (fixture file contents only). No secrets, no real document content, no unredacted user prompts. Metadata lives in this provenance file, not injected into the captured events.

cases.scenario: Background launch + terminal completion via read_subagent (re-capture of the 3000.6.14 C05)
cases.notes: Launch/terminal output strings IDENTICAL to 3000.6.14. NEW: the child's own Stop (file 0009) fires into the parent hook stream while the parent is blocked inside read_subagent — shares session_id+prompt_id, no agent identity field. Capture files 0002–0010.

Second read returns success:true again and re-serves the full report — still indistinguishable from the first terminal completion. block omitted (ABSENT, not false) on the non-blocking read. Capture files 0011–0012.

cases.scenario: Background launch; parent ends its turn WITHOUT reading (replies 'launched' and stops)
cases.notes: ANSWERED: a parent Stop DOES fire while a background subagent is still in-flight (parent Stop 0021 precedes the child's terminal read 0022/0023 and child Stop 0024); a second parent Stop (0025) fires after the completion notification under the SAME prompt_id. The 3000.10.21 'turn stays active' changelog does NOT suppress Stop — the pending-subagent carve-out is load-bearing. Capture files 0015–0026.

cases.scenario: Background agent whose approval-gated tool (exec curl) is auto-denied; parent reads it
cases.notes: Denied exec fires PreToolUse ONLY (0031, no PostToolUse); read_subagent STILL returns success:true 'completed' — the denial is invisible to the read classifier and visible only in the child Stop's last_assistant_message (0033). The binary's 'exited with an error' read string did NOT appear for this failure mode. Capture files 0027–0036.

cases.scenario: Cancel a running background agent from the panel, then read it
cases.blocker: Interactive only — cancelling a subagent requires the panel/TUI; headless -p cannot drive it (same class of blocker as C07/C08 ask_user_question on 3000.6.14). Any hook event on cancel and the post-cancel read output are NOT captured.
cases.owner: Requires an interactive UI session or owner-approved alternative capture strategy.

cases.scenario: run_subagent with resume:'<agent-id>' on a completed agent (foreground by definition)
cases.notes: NEW field: tool_input.resume takes the agent_id string; the resumed run is FOREGROUND (is_background absent), gets a NEW tool_use_id, and its completion output embeds the SAME agent_id — one agent_id has multiple launch/terminal cycles. The resumed child's tools + Stop stream identically. Capture files 0037–0056 (--permission-mode accept-edits).

cases.scenario: Foreground agent moved to background with Ctrl+B
cases.blocker: Interactive only — Ctrl+B is a TUI keybinding; headless -p cannot background an in-flight foreground call. What the already-returned PostToolUse said and how completion is later observable are NOT captured.
cases.owner: Requires an interactive UI session or owner-approved alternative capture strategy.

cases.scenario: SubagentStop registration — prove no such event is dispatched
cases.notes: NEGATIVE PROVEN: no SubagentStop capture file exists in any run; every run exited 0 with no startup error. In .devin/hooks.v1.json the key poisons the WHOLE file ('unknown variant `SubagentStop`' → loaded=0, zero capture files); in .claude/settings.json the same warning skips only that file (devin provider still loads 7). Unknown event keys are a per-FILE rejection, WARN only. SubagentStop exists in the binary solely as a ClaudeHookSpecificOutput OUTPUT variant.

unsupportedEvents.SubagentStop: NOT a loadable event key on 3000.10.31 (C16): in .devin/hooks.v1.json it poisons the WHOLE file ('unknown variant `SubagentStop`' → hooks discovery loaded=0); in .claude/settings.json only that file is skipped. Exists in the binary only as a ClaudeHookSpecificOutput OUTPUT variant (hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName). No SubagentStop capture exists in any run.
unsupportedEvents.PostCompaction: Registered in hooks.v1.json but not exercised (no compaction occurred during the short -p sessions). The synthetic payloads.json retains a PostCompaction fixture for compatibility.
unsupportedEvents.PermissionRequest: Not registered in this capture (7 events wired). Documented in lifecycle-hooks.mdx but not needed for the AIDLC adapter contract.
unsupportedEvents.SubagentStart/SubagentCompleted: ACP session-export event types only (cognition.ai/subagent_started, cognition.ai/subagent_completed) — NOT hook events and not registrable in either config file.

keyContractFindings.session_id: A short human-readable SLUG (e.g. 'sunny-cowbell'), NOT a UUID. Stable per session; each capture run is a distinct session. Unchanged since 3000.6.14.
keyContractFindings.prompt_id: A UUID v4, rotated per user prompt. Present on all events EXCEPT SessionStart (which fires before the first prompt). NEW: does NOT rotate when a subagent completion notification starts a new agent turn — C11's second parent Stop shares the original prompt's id, so multiple Stops per prompt_id are normal.
keyContractFindings.cwd: ABSENT on all captured events (unchanged). Project root is delivered via the DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR env var, not the payload.
keyContractFindings.tool_use_id: NEW FORMAT on 3000.10.31: '<internal-tool>:<n>#<32hex>' (e.g. 'run_subagent:0#a1b22c78…') for BOTH parent- and child-issued calls — the 3000.6.14 'chatcmpl-tool-<hex>' parent / 'functions.<tool>:<n>' child split is gone. The embedded internal tool name can differ from the hook tool_name (glob events carry 'find_file_by_name:0#…'). Still correlates Pre and Post; still NOT an identity contract.
keyContractFindings.tool_response: ALWAYS an object {success:boolean, output:string, error:string|null} on PostToolUse (unchanged).
keyContractFindings.agent_type: ABSENT on all captured events (unchanged — no new structured identity fields appeared on 3000.10.31). The adapter's devin.agent_type assumption remains NOT backed by real payloads.
keyContractFindings.agent_id: ABSENT as a top-level field on all captured events. Appears ONLY embedded in run_subagent/read_subagent output strings, as read_subagent tool_input.agent_id, and as run_subagent tool_input.resume.
keyContractFindings.tool_input.resume: NEW observed field on run_subagent (C14): takes an agent_id string to re-dispatch a COMPLETED agent; resumed dispatches always run FOREGROUND (is_background absent) and the completion output embeds the SAME agent_id, so agent_id alone does not identify one lifecycle.
keyContractFindings.stop_hook_active: NEW observed field on Stop events: boolean; false on every captured Stop (no Stop-hook block loop exercised).
keyContractFindings.last_assistant_message: NEW observed field on Stop events: the final assistant text of the turn that just ended — the ONLY content distinguishing a child's Stop from a parent's (Stop carries no agent_id/agent_type).
keyContractFindings.Stop: Fires for BOTH parent and subagent turn-ends into ONE hook stream sharing session_id+prompt_id. A parent Stop CAN fire while a background child is still in-flight (C11) — the 3000.10.21 'turn stays active' changelog does not suppress it. A child's Stop can land inside the parent's blocked read_subagent window (C05, C12).
keyContractFindings.DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR: Set to the project root by the CLI (env var, not payload). payload.cwd was never observed.
